english.title: Use an oversize vehicle in the Kingsway tunnels without express permission
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in the Kingsway tunnels

(A)_[the height of which (including any load) exceeded 5.00 metres]_
(B)_[the length of which (including any load) exceeded 12.20 metres]_
(C)_[the combined length of the vehicle and trailer, which (including any load or loads and drawbar), exceeded 18.30 metres]_
(D)_[the gross weight of which (including any load) exceeded 38 tonnes]_
(E)_[the width of which (including any load) exceeded 2.90 metres]_
(F)_[which did not come within any of the classifications of vehicles contained the Schedule of Tolls in force at the time]_

without the express permission of a Mersey Tunnels police officer or other authorised officer
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 10 and 16 of the Mersey Tunnels Byelaws 2003.
